coverageDefinition: Supplemental deterministic service-layer evidence. These entries do not count as Playwright or web/rest/mcp surface verification.

cases.reason: Supplemental Go interleavings cover account revocation after object I/O and membership revocation during upload. The separate native Playwright Linux regular-file lease scenario now proves the real local download boundary; its web evidence is recorded only by the browser reporter. Neither layer claims a Google Cloud Storage provider execution.

tests.name: TestNativeAssetBytesRecheckAccountAfterObjectIO
assertions: The wrapped object store disables the reader after opening the object, before the final authorization recheck.
DownloadAssetChunk returns an error and an empty DataBase64 string; no buffered private bytes are returned.

tests.name: TestUploadTransfersWithoutProjectLocksAndRechecksRevocation
assertions: A blocked upload holds zero acquired database connections while storage I/O is pending.
Membership is removed during the blocked transfer; after release the upload returns an error.
The attachments table contains zero published partial uploads.
